component.name: StickyNotes
component.summary: Keep short notes in small windows on your desktop

description.p: StickyNotes keeps short notes as separate small windows, in the style of Windows Sticky Notes. A list window finds and manages all notes.

ul.li: Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, bullet lists and note colors
Paste or drag images into a note
Search, and a bin that keeps deleted notes until you empty it
Notes are plain files in a folder you choose, so a folder that Nextcloud or Google Drive syncs works for backup
